roadmap.title: Zones 1 and 2
roadmap.description: Play Oboro Village, Lantern Festival and The Mountain. Claws and Cannon Punch unlock here; clear Ninjutsu, combo and heal achievements as you go.

roadmap.title: Zone 3
roadmap.description: Clear Neo City, Fish Market and Submarine Base in any order. Ninja Hook and Sword Dive unlock here.

roadmap.title: Zone 4
roadmap.description: Clear The Desert, Mad Train and ENE Corp Laboratory. The Glider and the last Ninjutsu arrive here.

roadmap.title: Finish the story
roadmap.description: Beat The Kaiju and The Assault, collect every Ninpo, and push the long combo.

roadmap.title: Collection cleanup
roadmap.description: With every Ningi, revisit stages for relics, Elite Squads, Ankou Rifts, Lab Keys and the shop, then fight the Shadow Master.

roadmap.title: Challenge modes
roadmap.description: Finish Boss Rush and Arcade Mode, the last post-story goals.

steps.text: Keep playing the story until the game marks the first zone as complete.
Keep playing the story until the game marks the second zone as complete.
Clear @loc{Neo City}, @loc{Submarine Base} and @loc{Fish Market}, in whatever order you like.
Clear @loc{The Desert}, @loc{Mad Train}, then @loc{ENE Corp Laboratory}.
Finish @loc{The Kaiju}, then @loc{The Assault}, and beat @enemy{Lord Ruse}.

achievements.summary: Reach a 30-hit combo in a real fight.

guide.context: The Training Room does not count.

steps.text: Fight a group of enemies and chain attacks until the hit counter reads 30.

guide.context: Most come from the story. Kunai Burst cannot be reached on the first visit because it needs Ninja Claws.

collectibles.name: Fire Ninpo
collectibles.method: Open the chest past the village checkpoint. You cannot miss it.

collectibles.name: Kunai Burst Ninpo
collectibles.method: Needs Ninja Claws. From @loc{Attic Shrine} go left, finish the spike-filled parkour, and open the secret chest.

collectibles.name: Thunder Ninpo
collectibles.method: Beat the stage boss, the Arachno Tank, then open its reward chest.

collectibles.name: Wind Slash Ninpo
collectibles.method: At the Secret Factory checkpoint go left, beat the waves, and open the chest that spawns.

collectibles.name: Shuriken Ninpo
collectibles.method: Beat the stage boss Mandara, then open the chest he leaves behind.

collectibles.name: Water Ninpo
collectibles.method: Buy it from the shopkeeper for 1 Oboro Clan Emblem and 3,500 gold.

collectibles.name: Bomb Ninpo
collectibles.method: Above @loc{South District Shrine}, ride the zipline near the shopkeeper into the room with the chest.

collectibles.name: Great Serpent Ninpo
collectibles.method: Near the Ascent checkpoint, go left where the path would turn right, beat the enemies, and take the Ninpo.

steps.text: Play the story until you have Ninja Claws, Cannon Punch, Ninja Hook, Sword Dive and the Glider.

achievements.summary: Obtain all four Ninjutsu: Karyu, Shisui, Raijin and Mijin.

steps.text: Keep playing the story until you own all four.

achievements.summary: Defeat every Elite Squad in all eleven stages.

guide.context: Each stage has two or three squads, and clearing a stage's full set gives a reward. Some squads need Ningi from later stages, and stages can be replayed from the map.

collectibles.name: Oboro Village squad 1
collectibles.method: Double jump and dash to the left ledge, break the Yokai Barrier with Cannon Punch, and step on the squad symbol.

collectibles.name: Oboro Village squad 2
collectibles.method: Cross the parkour section that needs Ninja Hook and Ninja Claws to reach the squad symbol.

collectibles.name: Lantern Festival squad 1
collectibles.method: Drop to the lower balloon platform and use the squad symbol on the left.

collectibles.name: Lantern Festival squad 2
collectibles.location: Rooftops, right side of the building
collectibles.method: Slide down and cross with Ninja Claws to the symbol at the top.

collectibles.name: Lantern Festival squad 3
collectibles.method: Sword Dive the Yokai Barrier by the island shrine and finish the parkour to the symbol.

collectibles.name: The Mountain squad 1
collectibles.method: Walk a few steps. The squad is on the main path.

collectibles.name: The Mountain squad 2
collectibles.method: Climb the walls with Ninja Claws to the chamber with the symbol.

collectibles.name: The Mountain squad 3
collectibles.method: Needs Ninja Hook and Ninja Claws. The reward is a Lab Key.

collectibles.name: Neo City squad 1
collectibles.method: Ride east, jump up before the building, and enter the upper room.

collectibles.name: Neo City squad 2
collectibles.method: Grapple up to the high platform with the symbol.

collectibles.name: Neo City squad 3
collectibles.method: Use the grapple points, solve the switch puzzles at the top, and start the squad. Needs the Glider.

collectibles.name: Fish Market squad 1
collectibles.method: Drop down after the zipline to the first symbol.

collectibles.name: Fish Market squad 2
collectibles.location: Storage secret zone, past the last relic
collectibles.method: Go left, climb the containers and left wall to the top middle containers.

collectibles.name: Fish Market squad 3
collectibles.method: Fast travel to @loc{Octo Sign Shrine}, leave by the right door, and go forward to the last squad.

collectibles.name: Submarine Base squad 1
collectibles.method: After destroying the first terminal, run up the left wall into the vent to the squad room.

collectibles.name: Submarine Base squad 2
collectibles.method: After the elevator-to-B3 terminal, go through the opened gate on the top-right platform.

collectibles.name: Submarine Base squad 3
collectibles.method: Stay on the upper level and keep moving right.

collectibles.name: Mad Train squad 1
collectibles.method: Run right to the train cart with the symbol.

collectibles.name: Mad Train squad 2
collectibles.method: Go right to the big cart ringed with explosive crates.

collectibles.name: Mad Train squad 3
collectibles.method: Enter the right-hand compartment, clear its enemies, and walk on to the symbol.

collectibles.name: The Desert squad 1
collectibles.method: Follow the main path past relic 1 to the squad.

collectibles.name: The Desert squad 2
collectibles.method: Ride the air currents up with the Glider, turn left, shove the yellow box away, and drop down to the symbol.

collectibles.name: The Desert squad 3
collectibles.method: Continue on the main route to the symbol ahead.

collectibles.name: ENE Corp Laboratory squad 1
collectibles.location: Lower area near the control center
collectibles.method: After breaking the Red Terminal, the symbol is in the lower part on the way back.

collectibles.name: ENE Corp Laboratory squad 2
collectibles.method: Follow the earlier main path toward the West Control Center to the half-open door.

collectibles.name: ENE Corp Laboratory squad 3
collectibles.method: Go right, take the lift down, and find the symbol in that room.

collectibles.name: The Kaiju squad 1
collectibles.method: Go right past the first glide; at the split, take the left path to the symbol.

collectibles.name: The Kaiju squad 2
collectibles.method: Drop down and keep heading left to the symbol.

collectibles.name: The Kaiju squad 3
collectibles.method: Take the passage across the acid pit and keep going down to the symbol after the last Pus.

collectibles.name: The Assault squad 1
collectibles.method: Keep going right. The squad is on the main path.

collectibles.name: The Assault squad 2
collectibles.method: Pass the relic chest and keep going left to the symbol.

collectibles.name: The Assault squad 3
collectibles.method: Head left outside, drop to a lower platform instead of climbing, and go through the left door.

steps.text: Start Boss Rush and beat the bosses back to back.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy while it is being healed.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy while it is being healed.

steps.text: Kill an enemy at the moment it is being healed.

guide.context: Keys 5 and 6 come late: Lord Ruse drops one after the credits, and the shop key needs all 55 relics.

collectibles.name: Lab Key 1
collectibles.method: From @loc{Freight Shrine} go left, cross the moving containers, and open the secret chest at the far end.

collectibles.name: Lab Key 2
collectibles.method: Clear the third Elite Squad in the purple zone near the bottom right of the Excavation Site. It needs Ninja Hook and Ninja Claws.

collectibles.name: Lab Key 3
collectibles.method: From @loc{East Lab Shrine} climb up to the room whose left gate is locked, take the lift around to the inside, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Lab Key 4
collectibles.method: From @loc{Throne Room Shrine} climb left, go down the far-left wall, take the right door, finish the long parkour, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Lab Key 5
collectibles.method: Defeat Lord Ruse. The key arrives after the credits.

collectibles.name: Lab Key 6
collectibles.method: Hand in all 55 Oboro Relics to expand the shop, then buy the final key for 10,000 gold.

steps.text: Play @loc{The Mountain} until the game gives you Ninja Claws.
Keep following the story until the game gives you Cannon Punch, which breaks Yokai Barriers on walls.
Play @loc{Neo City} until the game gives you the Ninja Hook.
Play @loc{Submarine Base} until you get Sword Dive near the end of the stage.
Play @loc{The Desert} and beat the Beastmaster to get the Glider.
Collect all six Lab Keys.
Go to @loc{ENE Corp Laboratory} and fast travel to the Containment Room checkpoint.
Use the machine in the middle with the keys, then fight and beat Shadow Master.
Keep playing the story until the game gives you your first Ninjutsu.

achievements.summary: Reach a 100-hit combo in a real fight.

guide.context: The Training Room does not count.

steps.text: Fight a large group and chain attacks until the hit counter reads 100.
Once you own Thunder Ninpo, use it on a group to push the counter up fast.

guide.context: Executions pay extra gold, so finish stunned enemies when you can.

steps.text: Pick up coins and chest gold through normal play and replays until the total reaches 40,000.

achievements.description: Parry 15 attacks with the Water Ninpo.

guide.context: Water Ninpo is bought in the shop. Boss attacks with clear warnings are easy to parry.

steps.text: Equip @mechanic{Water Ninpo}, which costs a Ninpo Cell.
Use it just before an attack lands to parry it. Repeat until you have 15 parries.

achievements.description: Purchased everything available in the shop.
achievements.summary: Buy every item in the shop.

guide.context: Handing Oboro Relics to the shopkeeper adds stock, so collect all 55 first, then spend gold until nothing new is left. Several relics need Ningi from later stages.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.location: @loc{Village Ruins Shrine}, back at the small wooden tower
collectibles.method: Smash the Yokai Barrier in the floor with Sword Dive, then open the chest under it.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.location: @loc{Antechamber Shrine}, right through the next rooms
collectibles.method: Beat the enemy group, follow the narrow passage past a second ambush, and open the chest at its end.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.method: Sword Dive through the barrier in the middle of the floor, climb the wall beside the Grim Reaper, and open the centre one of three chests.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.location: @loc{Collapsed Bridge Shrine}, chamber with the burning cauldron
collectibles.method: Go to the upper level, move far left, drop to the ledge below, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Open the chest on the ground. It is hard to miss.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.location: After the boat section, before the village
collectibles.method: Jump onto the roof and open the chest hidden behind the tree.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.location: @loc{Tower Shrine}, platform where the axe thrower stood
collectibles.method: Run up the right wall to a hidden platform and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.location: Just after relic 2, up and left
collectibles.method: Cross the dash points and blue balloons, beat the ambush, and open the chest that appears.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.location: Tower area, top of the zipline
collectibles.method: Before riding down, jump to the platform above, go left, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Slide down the right edge to the lower platform and open the chest guarded by a shield brute.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.location: @loc{Waterfall Shrine}, building with a pushable box
collectibles.method: Climb to the roof, drop in from the other side with the hanging points, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.method: After the trap passes, drop down, go left, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.method: Take the elevator up, cross left, run down the passage, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.location: After the Shopkeeper at @loc{Excavation Site Shrine}
collectibles.method: Go right, climb the yellow walls with Ninja Claws to the top, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Go right and climb the wall, ride the ramp down, grab the next wall, circle to the far side, and open the chest on the platform.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.method: Go right past the shop, cross three platforms, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.method: Use the grapple point under the left platform to reach the far side of the box and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.location: South District, where you broke the Yokai Floor
collectibles.method: After taking the second secret chest, throw the right-hand switch to kill the electricity, go back to the broken floor, and open the left chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.location: East District, after rescuing the hostage
collectibles.method: Climb the platform above while heading left, reach the next roof, Sword Dive the floor barrier, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Use the Glider, switch off the electric fields, and open the chest in the bottom far-left room guarded by a Ghost Samurai.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.method: Climb to the upper level, survive a second ambush, go right past the electric fields, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.location: @loc{Warehouse Shrine}, right side of the building
collectibles.method: Climb the wall, jump-dash left, keep climbing, and open the relic chest among the three in the upper right.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.method: Start the rotating platforms, go to the top-left corner, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.method: Ride the vertical containers up, head left, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Ride the moving container up, jump-dash left, and open the chest two containers further on. Reach this zone with Cannon Punch from @loc{Freight Shrine}.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.method: Go right, run up the wall into the vent, and open the chest in the small room beyond.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.method: Press the switch so a canister falls, shove it left, and use it as a step up to the raised chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.method: Push the yellow box past the flamethrowers, switch off the lasers on the upper platform, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.method: Lower the water, enter the room on the right, pass the rotating laser, and open the chest at the end.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Climb the wall, ride the elevator, use the Glider on the air currents in the flamethrower room, cross the long trap section, and break the Yokai Floor halfway to find the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.location: After the ambush past @loc{Aircraft Carrier Shrine}
collectibles.method: Sword Dive the Yokai Floor between the crates and open the chest below.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.location: Train car after the Arachno Tank fight
collectibles.method: Enter through the roof with Sword Dive, beat the two enemies, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.method: Enter from the far end, get past the explosive crates and bots, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.method: Shoot the explosive crates blocking the door with a kunai, beat the enemies, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.location: After the first chase past @loc{Armored Cars Shrine}
collectibles.method: Enter the compartment from its opposite end, beat the enemies, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.method: Slide down the ramp, take the path down and left, finish the parkour, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.method: Climb the right wall, break the Yokai Barrier, beat the enemies on the path, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.method: Clear the upper gauntlet, hit the crystal, ride the ziplines, jump from the bottom one to the side platform, and open the chest behind the barrier.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.method: Glide up the air current, go right through the hidden passage, finish the Glider maze, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Look for the small left platform and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.location: Before the room with @loc{Control Center Shrine}
collectibles.method: Leave the lift to the left, beat the enemy, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.method: After breaking the Red Terminal, go left, run up the wall into the vent, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.location: From the first Elite Squad encounter
collectibles.method: Enter the vent, follow it, drop down, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.method: Go right, drop through the opening, go left, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.location: @loc{Control Center Shrine}, east room at the top
collectibles.method: Open every gate, take the right lift, and glide up past the rotating lasers to the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.method: Instead of going down, glide right to the grapple point, finish the parkour, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.method: Go left, glide up the currents, take the right passage, cross the obstacles, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.method: Land on the small left platform and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.method: Climb the wall, go through the passage, break the Yokai Barrier, finish the parkour, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Drop down, go right, double jump to the ledge, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 1
collectibles.method: Beat the gauntlet to spawn the chest and open it.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 2
collectibles.method: Break the Yokai Floor past the two grapple points, beat the gauntlet, and open the chest that spawns.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 3
collectibles.method: Go left through the long obstacle section to the far side of the locked gate, flip the switch, go right, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 4
collectibles.method: Drop down, roll under the gap beneath the climbable wall, cross the falling pillars, and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Oboro Relic 5
collectibles.method: Break the Yokai Floors into the acid room, cross the left disappearing platforms, and open the chest on the ledge.

achievements.description: Earn an S rank on all stages in Arcade Mode.
achievements.summary: Earn an S rank on every Arcade Mode stage.

steps.text: Play the Arcade Mode stages again and again until each one ends with an S rank.

achievements.description: Complete a stage in Arcade Mode untouched.
achievements.summary: Complete one Arcade Mode stage without being hit.

steps.text: Clear one Arcade Mode stage without taking damage.

guide.context: Known sources are Max Health Boost, Max Kunai Boost and Ninpo Cell Boost chests.

steps.text: Take every secret chest and Elite Squad reward in all stages, and buy shop upgrades.

achievements.description: Kill the final boss in under 10 hours.
achievements.summary: Beat the last boss with under 10 hours on the clock.

steps.text: Play the whole story quickly and beat @enemy{Lord Ruse} with under 10 hours on the clock.

achievements.summary: Reforge the Dark Katana from the pieces earned in the Ankou Rifts.

guide.context: Each Ankou Rift is a challenge realm that rewards one Dark Katana piece, and ten pieces unlock the katana. The Assault has no rift. Many rifts need Ningi from later stages.

collectibles.name: Oboro Village rift
collectibles.method: Sword Dive. From @loc{Attic Shrine} go down to the burning floor, Sword Dive the barrier in the flames, and enter the portal beside the Grim Reaper.

collectibles.name: Lantern Festival rift
collectibles.method: Ninja Hook. From @loc{Buildings Shrine} reach the purple area, skip the balloon ride down, go right, wall run up, and climb the grapple points to the rift.

collectibles.name: The Mountain rift
collectibles.method: Ninja Hook and Ninja Claws. From @loc{Waterfalls Shrine} climb the wall to Mountain Peak, finish the platforming, and grapple to the rift.

collectibles.name: Neo City rift
collectibles.method: Glider. Beat the last Elite Squad in the West District, go right, and climb the grapple points to the rift.

collectibles.name: Fish Market rift
collectibles.method: Cannon Punch. In the Storage secret zone, after its Elite Squad, go right across the containers and slide to the rift. This realm is a combat challenge.

collectibles.name: Submarine Base rift
collectibles.method: Sword Dive. From @loc{Floor B3 Shrine} go left up the wall, break Yokai Floors and ride platforms, then wall-jump up the bottom-left shaft to the rift.

collectibles.name: Mad Train rift
collectibles.method: From @loc{Convoy Shrine} go left into the open train compartment where the Grim Reaper stands.

collectibles.name: The Desert rift
collectibles.method: Glider. In the Astral Labyrinth, after relic 4, drop to the lower section beside the portal.

collectibles.name: ENE Corp Laboratory rift
collectibles.method: From the entrance, go left instead of right and enter the vent.

collectibles.name: The Kaiju rift
collectibles.method: Ninja Hook. Drop down the hole left of @loc{Second Stomach Shrine}, head left, and grapple to the rift.
